config.title: Python-Abhängigkeitshinweis
config.registryUrl.description: PyPI-Registry-URL (für private Spiegel wie Artifactory oder devpi)
config.checkVulnerabilities.description: Genaue Versionen (==) gegen OSV.dev auf bekannte Schwachstellen prüfen
config.strategy.description: Update target: latest release, same maintenance line (compatible; 0.x stays within its minor), or same major.minor (patch). This is not a compatibility guarantee.
config.minimumReleaseAgeDays.description: Minimum release age in days. 0 disables the delay. When enabled, releases without timestamps are excluded. Known-vulnerability fixes follow the same policy; reduce the delay explicitly when needed.
config.ignoredVersions.description: Exact versions to ignore by package name, e.g. {"example": ["2.0.0"]}.
config.deferredPackages.description: Defer packages until an ISO 8601 date/time, e.g. {"example": "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"}.
config.targetPythonVersion.description: Concrete target Python version. When empty, read .python-version. If no concrete version is available, runtime compatibility is unknown.
config.validationCommands.description: Project checks to run in an isolated copy, as executable/args objects (no shell). Empty means tests are not run. Commands execute only when you choose Preview and Validate in a trusted workspace.
